dialog.title: App updates
dialog.description: Contacts only the source you enter and sends no identifiers.

done.bodyVerified: You can now check for newer releases.
done.bodyAndroid: Approve the installation in Android’s prompt. The VPN may disconnect briefly.
done.bodyWindows: Finish the Windows installer, then reopen SirinVPN.
done.bodyAppImage: Restart SirinVPN to use the new version. Restarting doesn’t disconnect the VPN. The previous version is kept for rollback.
done.bodyDebian: Restart SirinVPN to use the new version.
done.restartFailed: SirinVPN couldn’t restart. Close it and open it again to use the new version.

progress.verifyingBody: The signed release must match the installed files exactly.
progress.android: Approve Android’s installation prompt. SirinVPN checks the APK signature first.
progress.appImage: Replacing the AppImage. The previous version is kept for rollback.
progress.windows: Approve the Windows prompt. SirinVPN closes while the installer runs and keeps your kill switch setting.
progress.debian: Keep SirinVPN open. If installing fails, the previous version is restored where possible.

candidate.title: SirinVPN {{version}}
candidate.verifyOnce: Verify this installed version once to enable updates.
candidate.notNewer: This release isn’t newer than your version, so it can’t be installed.
candidate.notInstallableWindows: This copy can’t update itself. Install SirinVPN with the Windows installer first.
candidate.notInstallableLinux: This copy can’t update itself. Use the Debian package or an AppImage you own.
candidate.notReady: To install, disconnect and turn off the kill switch.
candidate.confirmVerify: I confirm verifying this installed version
candidate.confirmDebian: I confirm installing this verified Debian package
candidate.confirmWindows: I confirm installing this verified Windows package
candidate.confirmAppImage: I confirm installing this verified AppImage
candidate.confirmAndroid: I confirm installing this verified Android APK
candidate.confirmNote: Signing-key updates apply first and stay if installing fails. Retrying is safe.
candidate.footnote: This check is kept until you quit. Discard deletes the download; rollback copies stay.
candidate.confirmFirst: Tick the confirmation above to continue.

form.sourceHint: The HTTPS folder your SirinVPN releases are published in. Saved on this device for next time.
form.sourceInfo: Use the address your VPS updates from (VPS maintenance › Update VPS), or ask whoever set up your server. SirinVPN has no built-in address: it contacts only the one you enter.
form.noticeTitle: The check downloads the full update
form.noticeBody: Signed release metadata is verified first.
form.privacy: The source and your network can see your IP address and which package you request.
form.previewHint: Preview builds come early and may be less stable.
form.sourceFirst: Enter the release source to check.

error.discard: Couldn’t delete the download. Try again.
error.check: Couldn’t find a signed release for this device at this source. Check the address and channel.
error.installWindows: The Windows update didn’t finish. Try again; recovery data is kept.
error.installAppImage: Couldn’t confirm the AppImage was replaced. Reopen App updates to check it.
error.installDebian: The update didn’t finish and was rolled back where possible. Try again.
error.bind: Couldn’t verify the installed version. Nothing was changed. Try again.

recovery.androidNote: Android asks you to approve installs and may block downgrades.
recovery.pending: Version {{version}} is waiting for your approval in Android. Approve it, or cancel to check another release.
recovery.baselineRequired: Before your first update, check and verify the release for your installed version. Then check a newer one.
recovery.restored: AppImage {{version}} restored. Close and reopen SirinVPN.
recovery.restoreNote: Keeps your settings. Works only if that version is still trusted.
recovery.errorRestore: Couldn’t restore the previous AppImage. Try again.
recovery.errorCancel: Couldn’t cancel the pending install. Try again.

component.title: Update VPN component
component.description: Matches this device’s VPN component to the app version.
component.bundled: This app includes the matching VPN component. Installing it asks for administrator approval.
component.bundledInfo: Updating your server or replacing the AppImage doesn’t update this component.
component.updated: VPN component updated. You can connect from Home.
component.current: The VPN component is up to date.
component.disconnectFirst: Disconnect and turn off the kill switch first.
component.stepInstall: Install the latest SirinVPN app update.
component.serverNote: Server updates don’t update the VPN component on this device.
component.errorInstall: The VPN component wasn’t updated. Approve the administrator prompt and try again.
